appearances.title: Improved Customization + Glass + Browser Use
appearances.summary: This release introduces Qwen3.8-Flash-Next , polishes the Glass themes (now in Beta), adds a Composer position slider and lets models interact with files in the built-in browser. It also brings lower idle memory usage, preserved chat context when switching GGUF models, faster MLX loading and FP8 LoRA training. Highlights Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Dynamic V3.1 - 10-15% extra accuracy Guide Glass theme imp
